e7_s4_rejected.label: Invasive lobular carcinoma

e7_s4_rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: Typically presents as a large, rapidly growing mass, but imaging findings are not as strongly suggestive of malignancy as in this case

e7_s4_rejected.label: Metaplastic carcinoma of the breast
